tabs.content:
.create table website_visit_sample (
    visit_id: string,
    timestamp: datetime,
    page: string
)

.ingest inline into table website_visit_sample with (format="csv") <|
v001,2024-01-01T10:00:00Z,home
v002,2024-01-01T10:05:00Z,products
v003,2024-01-01T10:10:00Z,contact

website_visit_sample
| order by timestamp asc

.create async materialized-view with (
    docString = "without backfill materilized view"
) mat_view_no_backfill on table website_visit_sample
{
    website_visit_sample
    | extend visit_min = bin(timestamp, 1m)
    | summarize visit_cnt = count() by visit_min
}

mat_view_no_backfill
| order by visit_min asc


.create async materialized-view with (
    docString = "mat_view with backfill",
    backfill = true
) mat_view_backfill on table website_visit_sample 
{
    website_visit_sample
    | extend visit_min = bin(timestamp, 1m)
    | summarize visit_cnt = count() by visit_min 
}

mat_view_backfill
| order by visit_min asc 

.show materialized-views 

.ingest inline into table website_visit_sample with (format="csv") <|
v004,2024-02-01T10:10:00Z,contact
tabs.title: createMaterializedView

tabs.content:
.create-or-alter function get_visit_by_page(pageName:string )
{
    website_visit_sample
    | where page == pageName
    | extend visit_min = bin(timestamp, 1m)
    | summarize visit_cnt= count() by visit_min
}

get_visit_by_page("contact")
|order by visit_min asc 

.create-or-alter function get_page_name(pageName:string )
{
    website_visit_sample
    | where page == pageName
}

get_page_name("home")
|order by timestamp asc
